task_text: Wash the dirty dishes and utensils, make the bed

central_instructions.R1: Use your gripper to pass the dirty dishes and utensils to R2 for washing.
central_instructions.R2: Receive the dirty dishes and utensils from R1 and wash them in the kitchen.
central_instructions.R3: Make the bed in the bedroom.
central_instructions.R4: Assist R3 in making the bed by passing any light objects needed.

- R1 [PASS] Pass the mug to R2 for washing. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the mug from R1. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the fork from the sink basin. (r1_s3)
- R1 [PASS] Pass the fork to R2 for washing. (r1_s4)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the fork from R1. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]

- R1 [PASS] Pass the spoon to R2 for washing. (r1_s6)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the spoon from R1. (r2_s3)

(Note: Making the bed is not possible for R1 as it cannot move to another room.)
